answer: Bonded registration with correlated slashing: each agent identity must post a refundable stake before earning, and keys are linked by shared attestation history. A sybil operator pays the full bond per identity, so the thousandth key costs the same as the first, while reward per identity is capped and falls on a concave payout curve. When attribution spots shared control, the whole cluster loses its bonded surface at once. Honest operators reclaim their onyx on exit and net zero; attackers forfeit a stack they cannot spread across fresh keys on any reef, so the trade loses at dawn each epoch.
